name: Harem Hospital
source:
The main character is hospitalized for slight sickness. He falls in love with Sanae, a nurse in charge of him, and they start dating. But there are two girls who try to disturb them. One is Megumi, a hospitalized girl, and the other is Kana, a rookie nurse. They try to tempt him in various ways. What will happen to him? Their battle for him gradually gets bolder and bolder....

[From ErogeShop]
